summary: Itau Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a Form 6-K on August 5, 2026, disclosing its revised 2026 guidance via a Material Fact notice dated August 4, 2026. The filing, made pursuant to Rule 13a-16, updates the company's financial outlook, including a cost of capital assumption of approximately 14.75% p.a., and includes forward-looking statements subject to market conditions. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review is present. This is a routine regulatory filing of corporate guidance, not a special-situation transaction.
